title: dsc --diagnostics json
description: What `dsc compile`, `dsc check` and `dsc dump-ast` write to stderr under `--diagnostics json` ([RCLI.3.2]): one document, the diagnostics in the order the text form renders them. `additionalProperties: false` throughout, so a field is added only by a change to this schema. The residue this schema cannot carry is [RCLI.3.2]'s.

code.description: The diagnostic's code by name, never by number ([RCLI.5.1]). A reader keys on it: the message's wording is not a contract.

hint.description: Absent when the diagnostic has no hint, never an empty string.

related.description: Further locations the diagnostic names, in the order it names them; empty when it names none.

span.description: A source range: `start` is its first code point, `end` the position just after its last. `file` is the name the compiler gives the source ([RCLI.1.9]).

position.description: A 1-based line, and a 1-based column counted in Unicode code points.
